title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to make it easier for engineers to prototype agent-driven workflows. These templates are opinionated starting points (multi-tool orchestration, safe-fallbacks, structured outputs) and are accompanied by step-by-step quickstarts and runnable examples.

What this PR does: Adds a new docs section under /docs/rag with agent templates, publishes three quickstarts (python, typescript, and a CLI example) demonstrating tool-calling and structured responses, and lands runnable examples in redwood-examples/agents. Also updates site navigation and TOC so RAG content surfaces under "Guides -> Agents & RAG".

Checklist: 
- [x] Add agent templates (generic, search-first, tool-first)
- [x] Add Python quickstart showing tool registration and streaming responses
- [x] Add TypeScript quickstart with tool-calling + function signatures
- [x] Add CLI example for local testing with sample docs index
- [x] Update docs site sidebar and breadcrumbs
- [x] Add minimal test harness for examples (smoke tests)
- [x] Fix copy/typo feedback from reviewers

Testing: Ran docs build locally and verified navigation. Added lightweight smoke e2e that runs examples against the local mock-tooling harness (CI runs the smoke test during docs job). Manual run through of quickstarts by reviewer Maya Chen.

Migration notes: No breaking API changes. Examples reference the existing tool-calling APIs and the RAG utilities in redwood-examples; no action required from customers. The new docs include a short section on recommended quantization profiles when running templates on Redwood Dedicated.

Related: ENG-7421 (RAG templates initiative), PM-193 (launch content for beta).
